tests.notes: Final post-change results: backend fast suite 38 passed and 4 integration tests were intentionally deselected by the marker split; application coverage was 89%. PostgreSQL suite 4 passed and 38 fast tests were intentionally deselected; Alembic current returned 20260921_0001 (head) after the mismatch test restored the real test database revision. Frontend production build passed; Vitest passed 22/22 across 5 files; Playwright passed 6/6 in Chromium, including the newly automated direct /workspace/deep-link refresh and the complete Maria primary journey. Contract/project validation and both exact Railway watch-pattern assertions passed. A VITE_API_ORIGIN build embedded only the expected public API origin and the focused bundle scan found no operator token, database URL, or test-token literals. Existing tests also passed for exact bearer enforcement, reset enablement, bounded bodies, validation, generic client errors, structured redaction, exact CORS allow/deny behavior, deterministic reset with unrelated-row preservation, write-restart-read persistence, frontend loading/persisted/unavailable/retry states, and mobile accessibility. No test was flaky and no executed test was skipped. Two expected deprecation warnings were emitted by FastAPI/Starlette TestClient dependencies in each backend run; Playwright emitted the existing NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR warning. One npm invocation from the repository root failed with ENOENT and was immediately corrected by running the same script from frontend, where all 6 tests passed. Docker/Caddy container execution was unavailable because Docker is not installed; SPA routing was instead exercised through the required production Vite preview browser suite. Actual Railway service topology, private networking, deployment SUCCESS, restart, and post-deploy HTTP checks were not run because cloud deployment was explicitly deferred and no cloud access was attempted. The requested .agents/skills/testing/SKILL.md was absent from the repository and configured skill roots, so testing followed AGENTS.md and docs/standards/TESTING.md directly.
